title: improv·artist · mythic (Anselm Kiefer)
mutation_directive: improv artist: mythic via Anselm Kiefer

improv_extras.practice: ash, lead, straw; history as wound; vast leaden landscapes

v1.feedback: The Kiefer connection lands on multiple fronts — ash-to-lead-to-ochre palette, falling cinder particles, gold-vein highlights at the crest — and the differential-growth tower from 5gm gives it genuine monumental silhouette rather than a rebrand. Two refinements: the gold vein threshold (step 0.92) fires on ~8% of particles uniformly, so veins read as scattered sparkle rather than as linear gold-leaf seams — try routing vein intensity through a 1D noise along the curve index so gold clusters into actual vein streaks. Second, the cinder fall system (6k particles) should have its opacity decay tuned so ash lingers longer near the base, pooling into a visible ground plane of debris — right now they likely fade uniformly, missing Kiefer's signature accumulation of ruin at the foot of the monument.

v2.feedback: The differential-growth tower with Kiefer's ash-lead-ochre palette is well-executed — form is readable, the upward growth references both the 5gm lineage and Kiefer's ruined towers, and the gold-vein seams add material specificity without becoming decorative. The falling ash particles are a nice touch that sells the 'history as wound' read. Two things to push: the fog eats the base too aggressively at default camera, making the tower float rather than root in a landscape — either pull fog back or add a ground-plane debris field of scattered lead-grey points. Second, the gold veins feel evenly distributed; cluster them more toward seams/cracks in the growth topology (e.g. where edge length was recently split) to better reference Kiefer's actual gold-leaf application on fractured surfaces.
